prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en webbplats". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "website".
Scene: An adult viewing a laptop with a simple website layout and a large clock pictogram for opening hours, generic blocks instead of text, no brand, URL or readable interface text.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "webbplats = website; a place on the web.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Du hittar tiderna på vår webbplats.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
